verdict.rationale: Community users describe batch indexing of large datasets, such as 80M documents across 13 indexes and 1M records sent in one go. First-party docs only note adding documents and automatically generating embeddings for every document in an index. Users also report limits: default upload sizes too low, high memory use during batch imports, and indexing falling behind under heavy write loads. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of bulk/batch document APIs (bulk update, bulk delete by filter, batch task handling), evidence of bulk operations driven through the MCP/AI workflow, and a fix for the documented payload-size and write-throughput limits.
